# grammers-mtsender

`grammers-mtsender` connects to Telegram and exchanges requests and responses through the [Mobile Transport Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto).

This directory contains a narrowly patched copy of version 0.10.0 for use by `tgdl`. The patch scope, upstream revision, and maintenance requirements are documented in the [vendored patch overview](../README.md).
